topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It’s a small world, isn’t it? I was browsing through my social media feed the other day and saw a post from an online friend. We've had some great conversations, sharing interests and jokes, yet we've never met in person. Imagine my surprise when I saw they tagged a local spot, one I recognize clearly from strolling around my city. It turns out, they live just a few blocks away. I sent them a message, suggesting we finally meet up for coffee. It feels like a natural step, and I’m looking forward to it. Meeting in person can be exciting, adding a new layer to our friendship. I think it’ll be a great chance to get to know each other even better.
